texts.li: [tribal] {X_nameDef}, a spear-fighter of {FACTION}, has come to the gate with two spears wrapped in hide. {X_pronoun} teaches the young hunters of {PLACE} how to fight, and for {COUNT} silver will spend a day teaching the colony's fighters what {X_pronoun} knows, or sell one of the blades in {X_possessive} pack.

[medieval] {X_nameDef}, a master-at-arms of {FACTION}, rode in with a bundle of practice swords tied behind the saddle. {X_pronoun} trains the guards of {PLACE}, and offers the colony a day's teaching for {COUNT} silver, or a good blade from {X_possessive} pack for the same.

[industrial] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} teaches boxing, knife-work and marksmanship to the militias along the road. {X_pronoun} has stopped at the gate to offer a day's lessons for {COUNT} silver, and has a few blades to sell.

[spacer] {X_nameDef}, a combat instructor of {FACTION}, travels between settlements teaching people to fight when their weapons fail. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will spend a day with the colony's fighters, or sell one of the blades {X_pronoun} carries.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} makes a living teaching people to fight, and has stopped at the gate on the way to {PLACE}. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will spend a day with whoever does the colony's fighting, or sell a blade from {X_possessive} pack.

li.label: A day of hand-to-hand with {A_nameDef} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} spent the afternoon with {A_nameDef} in the yard, correcting {A_possessive} footing and guard over and over. {A_nameDef} is sore, and a good deal better at close fighting.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {X_nameDef} had {A_nameDef} fight with a blunted spear until {A_pronoun} stopped leaving {A_possessive} side open. {A_nameDef} is sore, and much harder to hit.
[!lowtech] {X_nameDef} took {A_nameDef} through the same three moves for most of the afternoon, until {A_pronoun} could do them without thinking.

li.label: A day at the targets with {B_nameDef} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stood behind {B_nameDef} at the targets all afternoon, fixing how {B_pronoun} breathes, stands and aims. By evening {B_nameDef} was hitting the mark far more often.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {X_nameDef} had {B_nameDef} shoot at a straw target until {B_possessive} arms ached, and showed {B_objective} how to judge the wind.
[!lowtech] {X_nameDef} made {B_nameDef} slow down and take each shot properly, and by evening {B_possessive} groups were half the size.

li.label: A blade from {X_possessive} pack for {A_nameDef} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} unwrapped the blades in {X_possessive} pack, let {A_nameDef} try the balance of each, and handed over the one that suited {A_objective} best.

li.label: Not today
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} wrapped up the practice weapons again and went on toward {PLACE}.

texts.li: [tribal] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} makes seats and frames of bent wood lashed with hide, and carries the tools for it in a roll on {X_possessive} back. For {COUNT} silver and some of the colony's wood {X_pronoun} will make a good seat for someone's sleeping place, or show the colony's own maker how the joints are done.

[medieval] {X_nameDef}, a joiner of {FACTION}, has come up the road with a bag of chisels and a saw. {X_pronoun} works for whoever will pay, and offers to make a proper chair for someone's room for {COUNT} silver and the colony's own timber, or to teach the colony's carpenter for half that.

[industrial] {X_nameDef}, a cabinet-maker of {FACTION}, is travelling to {PLACE} with a toolbox and a hand plane. For {COUNT} silver and some wood {X_pronoun} will make a good chair for someone's room while {X_pronoun} is here, or spend the day teaching the colony's crafter.

[spacer] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} makes furniture by hand, the slow way, and says people on the rim pay well for it. For {COUNT} silver and some of the colony's wood {X_pronoun} will make a chair for someone's room, or teach the colony's maker a few things.

{X_nameDef}, a joiner of {FACTION}, noticed that most of the colony sits on whatever is nearest. For {COUNT} silver and some of the colony's wood {X_pronoun} will make one good chair for someone's room before {X_pronoun} goes, or teach the colony's crafter for half that.

li.label: A chair for {A_nameDef}'s room ({COUNT} silver and 25 wood)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} worked at it all afternoon by the colony's woodpile, then carried the finished chair to {A_nameDef}'s room and set it in the corner.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {X_nameDef} bent and lashed the frame by the fire and carried the finished seat to {A_nameDef}'s sleeping place.

li.label: Show {B_nameDef} how the joints are cut (half that)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} spent the day at the bench with {B_nameDef}, showing how to cut a joint that holds without nails or glue. {B_nameDef} came away with sore hands and a better eye.

outcomes.li: [b:trait:TooSmart] {B_nameDef} wanted to know why every joint is cut the way it is, and {X_nameDef} was happy to explain. They were still at it after dark.

li.label: Nothing this time
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} shouldered the tools again and set off for {PLACE}.

IncidentDef.label: a carter in the cold months

texts.li: [tribal] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has dragged a sled up to the gate, piled with dead wood from the forest and bundles of dried grass. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will leave the wood for the colony's fires, or the grass for its animals.

[medieval] {X_nameDef}, a woodman of {FACTION}, has brought a cart up from {PLACE} loaded with split logs and hay. The cold is coming, {X_pronoun} says, and for {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will leave either load at the gate.

[industrial] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} drives a truck between the settlements in the cold months, selling firewood and baled hay. {X_pronoun} has stopped at the gate and offers either load for {COUNT} silver.

[spacer] {X_nameDef}, a hauler of {FACTION}, has pulled up at the gate with a load of cut wood and fodder, which {X_pronoun} says is still the cheapest way to stay warm and feed animals out here. Either load is {COUNT} silver.

[winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has come up the frozen road with a load of firewood and hay, and stamps the snow off {X_possessive} boots at the gate. {X_pronoun} will sell either load for {COUNT} silver.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} sells firewood and hay to the settlements on the road to {PLACE} while the cold lasts, and has stopped at the colony's gate. Either load is {COUNT} silver.

li.label: A load of firewood ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} took the silver and stacked the wood by the gate.

li.label: A load of hay for the animals ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} took the silver and unloaded the hay by the gate for the colony's animals.

li.label: A hot meal for {X_objective}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried a hot meal out to {X_nameDef}, who ate it at the gate and said {X_pronoun} would remember which colony had fed {X_objective} in the cold.

li.label: Nothing today
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} turned the load round and went on to the next settlement.

li.reason: The colony keeps no animals to feed.

titles.li: A master builder at the gate

texts.li: [tribal] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has built longhouses for half the camps between here and {PLACE}, and knows how to set a post so it doesn't rot. {X_pronoun} has stopped at the gate with a sled of dressed stone, and for {COUNT} silver will either sell the stone or spend a day building with the colony's best builder.

[medieval] {X_nameDef}, a master mason of {FACTION}, built the walls of {PLACE} and is on the road looking for the next job. {X_pronoun} has a cart of cut stone with {X_objective}, and for {COUNT} silver will sell it, or spend a day on the colony's walls teaching its builder.

[industrial] {X_nameDef}, a building engineer of {FACTION}, has a measuring tape, a roll of plans and a trailer of cut stone blocks. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will sell the blocks, or spend a day on site with the colony's builder.

[spacer] {X_nameDef}, a construction technician of {FACTION}, has built shelters in vacuum and in storms, and says most settlements build their walls the wrong way round. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will spend a day with the colony's builder, or sell the stone blocks on {X_possessive} hauler.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} builds for a living and has stopped at the gate with a load of cut stone. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will sell the stone, or spend a day showing the colony's builder how {X_pronoun} works.

li.label: A day on the walls with {B_nameDef} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} went round the colony's walls and buildings with {B_nameDef}, pointing out what was done well and what was not, and spent the afternoon showing {B_objective} how to do it properly.

outcomes.li: [b:trait:Abrasive] {B_nameDef} argued with {X_nameDef} about every wall, and lost most of the arguments. {B_nameDef} learned a great deal, whether {B_pronoun} admits it or not.

li.label: The cut stone ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} took the silver and unloaded the stone blocks by the gate, ready for the colony's builders.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} had a long look at the colony's walls, said nothing about them, and went on to {PLACE}.

texts.li: [tribal] {X_nameDef}, a hunter of {FACTION}, has followed the game to the colony's land and knows where it goes to drink and graze. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will take the colony's hunter out and show {A_objective} the trails, or sell some of the dried meat {X_pronoun} carries.

[medieval] {X_nameDef}, a huntsman of {FACTION}, has come to the gate on the way back to {PLACE}. {X_pronoun} has hunted this land for years and offers to take the colony's hunter out for a day for {COUNT} silver, or to sell the dried meat in {X_possessive} pack.

[industrial] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} guides hunting parties for a living, and has stopped at the gate with a rifle over {X_possessive} shoulder. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will take the colony's best shot out and show {A_objective} where the game is, or sell some of {X_possessive} jerky.

[spacer] {X_nameDef}, a tracker of {FACTION}, has been mapping where the animals move on this part of the rim. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will take the colony's hunter out to the best spots, or sell some of the dried meat {X_pronoun} lives on.

[winter] {X_nameDef}, a hunter of {FACTION}, has come in out of the snow and says the game on the colony's land is easy to track this time of year. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will show the colony's hunter where it goes.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} hunts this part of the land every year, and has stopped at the gate on the way back to {PLACE}. For {COUNT} silver {X_pronoun} will take {A_nameDef} out and show {A_objective} where the game goes, or sell some of the dried meat in {X_possessive} pack.

li.label: A day out with {A_nameDef} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} walked the land with {A_nameDef}, showing where the game goes to drink and graze and how to come at it from downwind, and pointed out two animals worth taking.

outcomes.li: [winter] {X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how to read the tracks in the snow, how old each set was and where it led, and pointed out two animals worth taking.

li.label: Buy {X_possessive} dried meat ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} took the silver and left a bundle of dried meat by the gate. It will keep for weeks.

li.label: Thank {X_objective}, and send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} nodded, shouldered {X_possessive} pack and went on {X_possessive} way.
